summary_for_children: Al-Qiyamah means The Resurrection. It says Allah can restore even our fingertips and teaches not to hurry when reciting.
environment_concept: A pattern of fingertip whorls in light on a stone (75:4).
architecture_and_scenery: Abstract sculpture of a hand made of light (no person), and a gentle path.

activities.name: Fingerprint
activities.description: Find four glowing whorls around the stone.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Do not rush
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (fingerprint, stones) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
